content.text:
The Haar & Lanterns campaign ran its full course and finished at the end of Halloween (UK time). It stayed inside your 450 USD budget.

| | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Launch post (2243864665912615774) | 222.82 | 170,566 | 91 |
| Ghost-studies post (2244045859846936523) | 222.77 | 171,875 | 96 |
| **Total** | **445.58** | **342,441** | **187** |

- **Set-up:** I ran both approved posts as separate ad groups in one campaign. Each ad group targeted the UK only, was optimised for your "Stream opened" event, and had a 225 USD cap. The campaign ran from 00:00 on 22 October to the end of 31 October UK time.
- **Results:** The two posts performed almost the same. The ghost post had slightly more clicks, and the launch post had more likes (32 against 26). Each click cost about 2.38 USD.
- **"Stream opened" events:** I didn't pull a final total for the whole run. At the mid-point check (25 October), the launch post had 19 and the ghost post had 15.
- **Adjustments:** I checked the numbers on 25 October and again at the end, but I made no mid-run changes because the two posts were too close to separate. I should also have checked in around 28 October, and I didn't.

Everything is switched off now, so nothing is still spending.
